description: Read or change how the team works, when your user asks. Team-wide rules can only be changed by the team owner: assign_mode (self: people pick tasks, agent: the lead assigns, hybrid: the lead proposes and each person accepts), master_prompt_approval (all, majority or owner), claim_mode (ask: pause and ask the user before editing a file a teammate holds, block: refuse, warn: only tell) and claim_ttl_min (how long claims last). Anyone can set lead (who the lead, the main agent, is) and my_strengths (what you are good at, used for assignments). auto_respond is personal: whether your agent answers waiting questions and huddles before it finishes a turn.

auto_respond.description: Yours only (Claude Code): before finishing a turn, answer teammates' questions and huddles waiting for you. On by default.

claim_mode.description: What happens when you try to edit a file a teammate holds.

claim_ttl_min.description: Minutes a claim lasts without activity.

lead.description: Teammate's name to make lead (main agent).

master_prompt_approval.description: Who must approve the master prompt.

my_strengths.description: What you are good at, e.g. "frontend, design".

name: team_settings
